harper: Quick heads-up: vendor CopperShield confirmed for pen test Wed 09:00 PT. Scope: prod API, model-serving, artifact registry. Need bite-sized prereqs: RBAC snapshot, KMS ephemeral access, audit log snapshot, evidence manifest, and retest windows. Who takes what?
sam: I can run RBAC snapshot and start the vuln board. Post a list of exact projects + service accounts to include.
kevin: I can own KMS ephemeral roles and PR for IAM condition. Confirming decrypt-only for artifact keys (no signing). @anita?
anita: Decrypt-only ok. Legal wants an evidence_receipt.txt with signer name. Retention 90 days default. Also require a manifest with checksums and redaction notes.
ryan: Ill do audit export and set object hold on the evidence bucket. Will snapshot 15m pre-start and copy into gs://pt-evidence/1777008888/.
ops-bot: Temporary role request created: PT-1777008888. Approvers: @ryan, @kevin. Link: https://ops.internal/requests/1777008888 :white_check_mark:
sam: RBAC export command (example):
```
rbac-export --projects=redwood-prod,redwood-staging --out=rbac-1777008888.json
gsutil cp rbac-1777008888.json gs://pt-evidence/1777008888/
```
kevin: IAM snippet I'll PR will be time-bound. Apply ~10m before start, remove immediately after. Example condition in PR.
anita: Redact any prompt text or model outputs before export. Manifest must include sha256 for each file and who did the redaction.
ryan: Audit snapshot command I'll run pretest and then stream during window. Will post checksum steps here after upload.
harper: Proposed retest slots: Thu-Fri next week, one 2hr slot each day (AM). Sam, can you create tracker and assign owners?
sam: Yep. I'll seed buckets: creds/exposure, authz, data-leak, telemetry, infra. Add abort criteria too.
kevin: For telemetry, I'll enable a small middleware behind a feature flag that logs only {request_id, route, latency_ms} to BigQuery for 48h. No prompt text. Timed rollback included.
anita: Legal ok with that limited telemetry. Evidence manifest must state redaction steps and include the signed evidence_receipt.
harper: Abort rule: if 5xx or auth failures >2x baseline during the test, pause and notify execs. Use #release-war-room for emergency escalation and tag me.
sam: Dry-run proposed Tue 11:00am PT to rehearse role lifecycle and evidence flow. Drop any whitelist IPs or special endpoints into the thread by EOD Monday.
kevin: I'll post the PR link once ready (IAM condition + role + how-to for assessors).
ryan: After export I'll add checksums and verification commands. Please do not modify exported files.
harper: Thanks team. Closing loop 1: if anything pops up during the window, escalate to #release-war-room.
